<noinclude>{{otheruses|a ranger's maximum hit|other uses|Maximum hit}}
'''Maximum ranged hit''' is a term used to describe the highest amount of damage rangers can inflict. Currently the maximum ranged hit is 110 in PvM. In PvP, the max hit is ~79 with [[dragonstone dragon bolts (e)]] and max ranged damage gear.

==Maximum hit conditions==
*Weapon: [[Zaryte crossbow]]
*Ammunition: [[Ruby bolts (e)]]
*Opponent: [[Tumeken's Warden]]/[[Elidinis' Warden]]
*Armour: None
*Other: Raid level must be 600 and party size must be 8.
At maximum raid level and party size, the damaged Warden in phase 3 has 17,350 hitpoints. Thus, in theory, Ruby bolts (e) would be capable of hitting a 3,470 when the Warden has taken no damage. However, this effect has been capped at a maximum of 100; if a [[Zaryte crossbow]] is used, the damage cap is increased to 110 upon activation.

Note that the max hit with ruby bolts (e) is a special effect of the bolts unaffected by equipment bonuses and Ranged level.

The maximum total theoretical damage from one ranged attack is 473, achievable by using the [[Dragon crossbow]] special attack on accurate with a [[Slayer helm (i)]], damaging 9 monsters on-task, dealing 67 damage to the primary target and 44 to the other 8.
==Calculating your maximum ranged hit==
</noinclude>

===Step one: Calculate the ''effective ranged strength''===
<math>\text{Effective Ranged Strength } =\Bigg \lfloor \bigg ( \Big \lfloor \big( \text{Ranged Level}+\text{Boost} \big) \times \text{Prayer Bonus} \Big \rfloor +\text{Atk Style} + 8  \bigg ) \times \text{Void Modifier} \Bigg \rfloor</math>

If you are using the accurate attack style ''Atk Style'' is 3 while all other styles are 0.

''Void Modifier'' is 1 if not wearing void, 1.1 if wearing full ranged void, or 1.125 if wearing full elite ranged void.

'''Ranged Level boost:'''
{{main|Temporary skill boost}}
{{:Temporary skill boost/Ranged}}

'''Prayer Multiplier:'''
{| class="wikitable"
<tr><th colspan="2">Prayer</th></tr>
|-
|[[Sharp Eye]]
|1.05
|-

|1.10
|-

|1.15
|-

|1.18
|-
|[[Rigour]]
|1.23
|}

===Step two: Calculate the ''maximum hit''===

<math>\text{Maximum Hit} = \left\lfloor \left\lfloor 0.5+\frac{\text{Effective Ranged Strength} \times (\text{Equipment Ranged Strength}+64)}{640} \right\rfloor \times \text{Gear Bonus} \right\rfloor</math>

The maximum hit is the largest hit you can possibly do with the current setup. It can be tested by using the [[Combat dummy]] in a [[Player-owned house]].

The Equipment Ranged Strength can be found in the Equipment Stats window under 'Other bonuses'.

If slaying monsters on task while wearing a [[Black mask (i)]] or [[Slayer helm (i)]], the gear bonus is 1.15.

If killing [[Undead]] monsters while wearing a [[Salve amulet (i)]] or [[Salve amulet (ei)]], the gear bonus is 7/6 (1.167) or 1.2 respectively.

Note that these two bonuses DO NOT stack.

In the wilderness, [[Craw's bow]] and [[Webweaver bow]] give a gear bonus of 1.5. This bonus stacks additively with a Black mask(i) or Slayer helm (i), for a total of 1.65, and multiplicatively with the Salve amulet (i) or (ei).

[[Twisted bow]] damage modifier is also included in the gear bonus and does stack with slayer/salve (multiply by both modifiers). However, the tbow modifier is less straightforward to calculate as it is not constant: see its page [[Twisted bow|here]] to calculate it based on your opponent.

===Step three: Calculate the ''bonus damage''===
<math>\text{Max Hit} = \big \lfloor \text{Base Damage} \times \text{Special Bonus} \big \rfloor</math>

The following special attack/effect bonuses apply, bolts '''only''' apply when the special effect activates:
